title: LangGraph Checkpointing: How to Resume an AI Agent After a Crash
excerpt: A timeout killed my five-step agent run and took every paid token with it. Here's how LangGraph checkpointing lets a crashed agent pick up exactly where it stopped, with tested code and the pitfalls that bit me.
seo_title: LangGraph Checkpointing: Resume AI Agents After a Crash
meta_description: Learn how LangGraph checkpointing saves agent state after every step, so a crashed run resumes where it stopped. Tested Python code, SQLite setup, pitfalls.

social_message:
A timeout killed my 5-step agent run, and every token I'd paid for went with it.

LangGraph checkpointing saves the full state after every step, so a crashed run picks up from the exact node that failed. I crashed an agent on purpose to test it, compared the three durability modes, and wrote down the pitfalls that cost me the most time.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/langgraph-checkpointing/
